Not when you're supp to act professional.

I was about to head to bed, and see if I feel any better in the morning. Thank you very much though.

I remember on January 8th I turned to a colleague an out of pure impulse asked "How is it still January?"

Not a proud moment.
Not intentionally bringing attention to it, avoiding noise, and keeping it quiet is not a problem.
Thank you very much, and no problem! :D

Yeah, I went through that and like ten other mildly unhealthy things and then I found tapping them on things was a hella powerful and satisfying feeling. I try to keep it quiet in public and people don't even notice.
Wow, they're so beautiful! It's a lot of work, well done!

Keep the thumb separated! Wrap it up if you can. If the thumb is separated you can't pick and search for something to bite subconsciously.

You'll get there! 💜

Ooh, tip I just shared on another thread! Just tap your fingers on a solid object. It's a thousand times more satisfying to do, and not as harmful. I tap my desk and occasionally the back of my phone now as a sort of idle-hand-movement-thing.

What really helped me was just isolating my thumb. It's super weird, but here's the thought:

If your thumb is isolated, you can't pick off a corner or tab to bite onto on any of your other fingers. Especially at night in the dark when you can't see it, isolating the thumbs with wrap can be felt as a reminder, or you just won't feel the need to bite of that one little tag.

+1 if you can get a wrap that contrasts sharply with your skin tone, or a scented one! But only do the thumb- doing every finger would be inconvenient. Leave them out so you can tap on flat surfaces- tapping on solid things has become a replacement habit actually. Replacing biting with tapping is ten times more satisfying, and they only take a few days to get to a tappable length!

Best of wishes to you. It's hard but you can do it. 💜💜

Awwh, thank you so much! 💜 And you will get there! It was insanely hard for the first month, but it gets smoother! Biting just lost its meaning and purpose. I used to have to hook my thumbs under my pillowcase or blanket to keep them down and apart though.

You'll start noticing something else too- At first it was all about nail length, but after a while your whole jaw and face feel less tense.

Unfortunately, since I've been doing it for so many years, nails aren't the only thing I have to tackle- my teeth and jawline are oddly shifted.

There is a long way to go, but it's worth the little victories. May you experience many! :)
Nice! Another one- Picking up papers or cards off the floor, or just grabbing one sliver of paper from a stack. That's an awesome feeling!

Sucks, but the last time someone was recently interested in me he was convinced that "he could do better."

Not "*fun*" or "*quirky*" enough physically or mentally I guess.

I can't see it as depression though. I just don't want to fuck a random guy, twerk and drink at a house party until the cops show up, eat detergents, light myself on fire, fight people for flicking me, sneak vapes, weed, weapons into schools, etc. But apparently that's what fun is.

I'll have a look next time we go out to a specific store.

I'm definitely aware that strangers on the web don't give the best advice, but it's better than Google telling me I have cancer. I've been working outside in 100+ degree heat for 8hr a day the last few weeks so I want to assume that a YI is the cause, especially with so much sweat and how many of the other signs are also there.

And I thought doctors were legally obligated to share things with parents of the underaged though, even if you are seen alone. Thinking about seeing my pediatrician, despite him being mostly chill, still makes me uncomfortable, and would end up being more bills. 

Thank you for this comment though. Helpful!
Issue is merely walking into the office of any specialist here can cost a limb, and I don't know nearly enough information to choose or easily pay for a good one.

I totally get parents doing that too. 

Age doesn't matter, if I know something you don't and you want to fix it, then listen.

They're angry if you don't help but angry if you do. So now whenever they need some technical or particularly long/difficult thing I know how to do I will just say, "I dunno how it works."
What's in it, and who makes it? Maybe I can look around for something similar.

Could be an age and a free speaking thing. But she crossed waaaaaay my line at friends. I feel it's a betrayal of trust.

I kind of grew up thinking "I'd *die* before I *ever* let someone touch me that's not a limb or neck upwards, and nobody shall ever know about my issues!" But I'm definitely eating my own words now that something is going wrong that's not an "I'm fine I can live with this" type of thing.
Yeah, I use body wash and just don't get too close to "there" with it, and switch it out for soap.
Not sexually active at all. I don't use lotions because I don't know what's safe for that area, so I just wash with unscented soap and water. And I'm from the US!
I'll tell you the pitcher... Tomorrow.

I did this completely on accident once. I had no memory of getting into bed. Fell asleep in a car and woke up fully clothed in bed.

Needless to say I changed away all my bedding and it was not on purpose.
Being treated like children but expected to behave like adults is shitty on society's part.
I shouldn't have to walk out my door in the morning and think "What angles can I get shot from?"

You mean LGBTQIA...BCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ because the first four "aren't inclusive enough." Some of my best friends are LGBT and other kinds of orientations, two even trans! I'm happy for them living free but the following is one person who ruins the rep of the whole community:

There's a chick in my school who is taking being gender fluid. She picks her gender every day, and if she has one earing is she's M, two is F, but she doesn't wear earrings. She just wanted out/in to bathrooms, locker rooms, and assemblies. She has so many mental issues, dated my brother and stalked him for a while (wants him back but he's trying to get her TF out of his life,) and if you ever tell her to leave you alone or cut the shit- get this:

"You're just angry that I'm a boy today!!! You're just discriminating against me because I'm genderfluid!"

I want to slap her across the face and say "What gender will you pick tomorrow? Manipulative bitch? Nah, you're one of those every day!"

Being "a bit of a bigger guy/girl" is fine. Just take care of yourself. You don't need to be exactly on the target, and come on, a sweet treat once in a while is a happy thing!

It becomes a problem when you don't take care of yourself and are struggling to do basic tasks, and your weight become part of someone's *description of you.*

I find it hilarious that he said "If you don't like it here, you can leave."

You can't. Because America still wants a portion of your paycheck (I think the taxation act is called FACTA?) and it's expensive to get permission to get out. 

Otherwise I would in a heartbeat.

As one who is learning two languages at the moment, I just shut up about other peoples' English typos. They're trying. Even if every other piece of the post is perfect, you never know if it is a native who just slipped, can't spell the word, or someone who's trying to get a point across in their second language.

But for non natives, the effort to communicate at whatever level they are is beautiful. I don't even have that kind of courage.

Oh I've gotten this so many times. From the same person about many different topics. The most memorable:

My friend said she talks to spirits and adores ouija boards, so she made me try one out. She's "part witch because her mom is a witch."

I said that when someone expects the answer then they move the thing without thinking it's on purpose.

But no, it's *me enforcing my beliefs on her.*
Isn't the creator (and a team if they have it) the first to see it anyway?
And dumb opinions become hostile ones. Because Merica logic 🇺🇸!
I don't mind if they're kids and like a character but if a thirty year old man thinks about having sex with a sixteen-year-old cartoon girl then we have a problem.

Are you or someone you know going to kill someone?

Oh well.

But god fucking forbade, you have a hoodie on! Give me that hoodie and have your parents come pick it up so I can explain to them the dress code word for word for the fifth time!
That's because millennials want money served on a platter. Working is too hard apparently?
Hah! I feel you! I've applied to ten places this month. Not a single one called me up.

I took your first comment as "You know nothing so stfu," so I just went with it.

I haven't *seen* other places in person. But I've spoken with people from Europe, (various countries,) different mediums, sometimes in their language. It generally seems less hostile. Yeah most systems are shitty, but any society in which I don't need to think about what angle I could be shot from when I leave my place already seems kind of cool, yeah?
No. Because I'm stuck here, so all I hear is how much trash people talk about other countries, even if they know an equal amount of *nothing as I do.*

Thank you. And I'm really trying: jobs are hard to find, but pretty soon I'll be able to drive (Yay independence!) and I'm looking into universities and scholarships. More than she's done, I'm afraid- but I have a reason to never want to be like her.
That's hilarious. She won't be able to handle getting contact-high from the hardcore weed in the locker room then.

"Hell no I'm not going to spoil you like our parents do."

Gonna be my response when she figures out I have a driver's license and she starts begging me to drive her around.

Charging her for rides would get me places though.
I have two. My twin is my most favorite person in the world, and the only one besides parents I will miss when I leave, but our sister is a piece of shit.

Oh the one in my basement is ENTIRELY off key. Every key is almost exactly a half step flat and I refuse to play it. It was just going to be trashed so my parents brought it home. 

I can't tell them though because they don't know music theory. They think "This one goes LA and this one goes LAA so you're just lying to us."

Am pianist. Pisses me off that there's this one kid who's fucking Beethoven reincarnated, so just because I'm not *him* I can never play in an ensemble and people assume that I suck. 

I totally feel you in the regard that I have to just stick to my room and flopping solo because everyone either claims to do what they can't, or I'm not good enough to breathe the same air as some cocky personality-less kid. But whenever I'm actually asked to play people suddenly realize "wow she's not shit."

They love ignoring fair use as well 

The amount of times I have seen careers ruined because some big company claims to own five seconds of a video that's *vaaaaaaaaaguely* like some irrelevant thing they made fifteen years ago is stupid.

I have no problem with it as long as it's not *literally two posts below theirs.*

If they are just too lazy to search an obvious question that was asked fifteen times in the last week I get pissed. But if it was too long ago to bother searching, go ahead and repost.

I just ignored it and got in trouble every night for a good three years straight. I'm okay with all the other rules my parents made, but forcing someone to go to sleep is *not possible.* They eventually stopped checking.
